name: simple-ai-tracker
description: Simple AI Tracker — self-contained issue tracker for AI agents: SQLite storage, REST API, MCP server and Angular kanban board.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.start:with-build: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.doctor: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs doctor
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs db:migrate
scripts.db:backup: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs db:backup
scripts.db:backups: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs db:backups
scripts.db:restore: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs db:restore
scripts.import:json: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs import:json
scripts.export:json: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs export:json
scripts.db:stats: npm run build:server && node dist/server/cli.mjs db:stats
